description:
You're listening Sam & Dave's iconic soul anthem "Soul Man". Sam Moore has recorded a new version of "Soul Man" with Spanish recording artist Pitingo! Check it out here http://bit.ly/SoulMan2019 Written by Stax legends Isaac Hayes and David Porter, "Soul Man" peaked at #2 on the Billboard charts on Nov. 4, 1967.

Comin' to you on a dust road
Good lovin', I got a truck load
And when you get it, you got something
So don't worry, cause I'm coming

I'm a soul man, I'm a soul man
I'm a soul man, I'm a soul man, I've got it all

Got what I got the hard way
And I'll make it better each and every day
So honey, don't you fret
Cause you ain't seen nothing yet

I'm a soul man, I'm a soul man, play it Steve
I'm a soul man, I'm a soul man

I was brought up on a side street, listen now
I learned how to love before I could eat
I was educated from good stock
When I start lovin', oh, I can't stop

I'm a soul man, I'm a soul man
I'm a soul man, I'm a soul man

Well, grab the rope and I'll pull you in
Give you hope and be your only boyfriend
Yeah, yeah, yeah, yeah
